content:
incident-bot: PAGER — Policy runtime exception detected in smart-routing service.
incident-bot: severity=sev2, alert=policy_engine.runtime_exception, affected_route=customer-model-route-84, symptom=repeat fallbacks between eu-west-1 <-> us-east-1, 5xx rate up ~38% for the last 2m. Paging oncall @maria oncall.

maria oncall: on it. joining handoff channel now. can someone paste the failing expr?

lee (routing): pasting from logs — looks like an unhandled value in match expression that tries to call `.toLowerCase()` on null.

```
match request.metadata.region {
  case r if r.toLowerCase() == "eu-west-1" => variant = "v2-quant"
  case _ => variant = "v1"
}
```

sam (eng): oh — the policy language doesn't null-check before calling method. that `.toLowerCase()` can throw. we've seen this with missing metadata keys in edge cases.

noah (sre): impact: approx 2.1k requests/min hit that route, fallback thrash causing connection errors in eu-west-1 and filling queued requests in us-east-1. downstream latency spikes seen at 95th from 80ms -> 420ms. customers experiencing degraded responses and a small % of 5xx.

anya (support): I'm triaging incoming customer reports — flagged two active customers with timeouts. I raised a priority ticket and set expectations: engineering is looking into routing config.

maria oncall: mitigation plan: 1) disable policy engine rule for customer-model-route-84 to stop evals; 2) add static route override to pin to v1 in eu-west-1; 3) roll a hotfix to add safe-navigation operator in the expression. doing 1 and 2 now.

sam (eng): I can deploy the console-disable API call. running:

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/policies/disable \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"policy_id":"route-policy-84","reason":"runtime-exception - temporary disable"}'
```

sam (eng): API returned 202. Policy disabled.

maria oncall: adding route override via routing-admin: set customer-model-route-84.variant=\"v1\" in eu-west-1 for 30m TTL.

lee (routing): override applied. monitoring rollback metrics.

noah (sre): backend errors dropping. 5xx back down to baseline in 90s. queues draining. latency returning to normal.

anya (support): updating affected customers: "We've applied a temporary routing override and disabled the risky rule; your requests should stabilize. We'll follow up once fully validated."

maria oncall: root-cause summary for now: policy expression assumed metadata.region is always present and called `.toLowerCase()`. Null deref caused an unhandled exception in the policy VM which aborts evaluation and triggers fallback routing. fallback oscillation between regions caused capacity thrash and increased 5xx/latency.

sam (eng): immediate next steps: open PR with safe-check + unit tests for policy language; add static analyzer to catch method calls on nullable types; add runtime guard in policy VM to fail-safe return a passthrough variant instead of panicking.

lee (routing): ops follow-ups: add circuit-breaker for repeated policy eval failures to avoid region thrash; create a dashboard for policy-exceptions by route + customer.

noah (sre): oncall doc updates: escalate to sev1 if >10% 5xx sustained for 5m or if a single customer sees >90% requests failing.

maria oncall: I'm putting a short incident note into the tracker: affected customers, mitigation (disabled policy + override), metrics improvement, owner=sam for fix, owner=lee for ops guard. scheduling incident review for tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

anya (support): thanks — I'll resume customer comms and send a follow-up once the PR is merged. :thumbsup:

sam (eng): quick snippet for fix I'm about to push — safe navigation:

```
match request.metadata.region {
  case r if r != null && r.toLowerCase() == "eu-west-1" => variant = "v2-quant"
  case _ => variant = "v1"
}
```

maria oncall: thanks team. leaving handoff note and closing paging loop. reopen thread for postmortem if needed. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident closed (auto) — policy_engine.runtime_exception resolved by mitigation. Incident ID: INC-2026-2177654321.
